cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

mechanism: Copy a stage manager's tape placement without knowing it marks positions, then claim deliberate reinforcement once the accidental strip catches a falling curtain.
confusable: Not ordinary overlooked craftsmanship: B2 must reveal the copied tape's different purpose and A must preserve confidence when seeking the later credit.
comparison: Stage failure reveals a concrete saving effect, unlike a household lockout.
seedUse: Retains untidy tape saving curtain/finale and named credit; adds taped position mark misapplied across curtain seam.
